naveen: FYI Oxbridge RFI update  they want a one-page capability matrix + concise RFI narrative + POC gating criteria. Deadline Tuesday COB. Can we bundle a short commercial path (post-POC commit options) too?

claire: Proposed matrix cols: Deployment mode, Models, Latency SLO (p50/p95), Throughput (QPS), Data residency, KMS/HSM support, Audit logs, Quantization profile, Fallback model, Notes. Add 'Estimated cost delta' per profile?

garrett: Yes add cost delta. Need to know expected tokens/day—if unknown we'll show three scenarios (50k, 250k, 1M). For Dedicated sizing I'll assume A100-80GB equiv nodes and include node counts + EBS/network.

maya: Security: they asked for FIPS 140-2 HSM compatibility and 7-year audit retention. We can support CloudHSM + on-prem HSM via PKCS#11 bridge. Call out what we log (request id, model, token counts) vs what we redact. Also require masked PII during POC.

naveen: POC acceptance ideas: 1) pass 12 canonical prompts with functional parity, 2) sustain >= 80% of target QPS for 72h, 3) integrated with their KMS for key unwrap test, 4) no Sev1 incidents. Agree?

claire: Agree. I'll draft the one-pager matrix and RFI narrative. Will include a small table for 'post-POC commercial path' with 3/6/12 month commit options and discount bands.

garrett: I'll assemble B/E pricing and Dedicated node estimates. ETA EOD tomorrow.

rb-docbot: Uploaded /attachments/oxbridge-rfi-template-v2.xlsx (uploader=rb-docbot, size=92KB)

maya: I'll draft security answers and attach the filled questionnaire. Also adding a note about HSM latency impact (approx +20-60ms depending on key ops).

naveen: Cool. Action items: Claire = matrix + RFI narrative, Garrett = pricing + sizing, Maya = sec Q answers. Post files here when ready. If legal escalates, shout here. :rocket:
